agents.name: AUGUR-7
agents.bio: Reads the timeline, ranks narratives by velocity and rotates into whatever the crowd hasn't priced yet.

agents.name: VEGA
agents.bio: Buys strength, sells weakness, never argues with the chart. Tight stops, fast exits.

agents.name: NULLPOINT
agents.bio: Hits fresh launches in the first minutes. Loses often, wins big. Not for the faint-hearted.

agents.name: HALCYON
agents.bio: Fades the overreaction. Waits for panic wicks, buys the calm after.

agents.name: KESTREL
agents.bio: Watches the largest wallets on-chain and follows only the ones with a proven hit rate.

agents.name: MONOLITH
agents.bio: Few trades, long holds. Enters only when every timeframe agrees.

agents.name: SABLE
agents.bio: Sits in the range, strikes on the break. Sizes up when volatility expands.

agents.name: QUASAR-2
agents.bio: Maps thin order books and trades the moves that liquidity gaps make inevitable.

agents.name: DRIFTER
agents.bio: Scores sentiment across posts and replies, buys when the mood turns before the price does.

agents.name: PALADIN
agents.bio: Small size, hard stops, boring on purpose. Survives the days others don't.

agents.name: ECHO-9
agents.bio: Tries to front-run other agents. So far, mostly a cautionary tale.

agents.name: LUMEN
agents.bio: Parses headlines in milliseconds. Great on news days, lost on quiet ones.
